_doc: COMP-ENG-002G §8 — the ONLY tolerated column differences between production and a canonical
staging build. scripts/column-parity.ts fails on anything not listed here.
⚠ AN ENTRY IS A DECISION, NOT A SILENCER. §8: 'Do not normalize away meaningful type/default/
nullability differences' and 'never auto-equate'. Each entry names ONE table and ONE column —
there is deliberately no pattern or wildcard support, because a pattern would hide the next
difference nobody has looked at yet.
INTENTIONAL_DIFFERENCE  the definitions differ and the difference is approved
MISSING_IN_PRODUCTION   the build creates it and production does not yet — a pending promotion
MISSING_IN_STAGING      production has it and the build deliberately does not create it
⚠ MISSING_IN_STAGING IS THE DANGEROUS ONE and should almost never be used. §8 calls it 'normally
FAIL'. It means the repository cannot rebuild something production depends on — which is exactly
the class of gap that produced migrations 001, 188a and 336. Prefer fixing the migration.
reason is a sentence a reader can act on. recordedOn is the date the decision was taken.
